t.E957.agn: In its 2021 re-evaluation, EFSA considered it unnecessary to set a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and reported no safety concern at the highest permitted use levels. The likelihood of allergy via the oral route was found to be low based on animal studies, and no conclusion could be drawn from human data; allergy from inhaling its dust in the workplace has been reported, but this was not considered relevant to dietary intake.
t.E957.body: In the digestive tract, thaumatin is readily digested like other proteins.
t.E957.prod: A protein obtained by extraction from the katemfe fruit.
t.E957.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI considered necessary, no safety concern.
t.E957.summary: A very sweet protein obtained from a fruit native to Africa. Used as a sweetener and flavour enhancer.
t.E957.what: A sweet protein obtained from a tropical fruit, used as a sweetener and flavour enhancer.
